name: genome/train/list-jobs
description: List all training jobs with status, progress, checkpoints, and node info. Shows running, completed, crashed, and resumable jobs. Use genome/train/resume to restart crashed jobs from their latest checkpoint.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by job status: pending, running, checkpointed, completed, failed, crashed, cancelled

params.name: nodeId
params.description: Filter by grid node ID (e.g., '100.124.122.107' or 'local')

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of jobs to return (default: 20)

results.name: resumableCount
results.description: Number of crashed jobs that can be resumed

examples.description: Show jobs running on the 5090 tower
